**Download:** `PingWatch-{version}-setup.exe` to install it, or `PingWatch-{version}-portable.zip` for a portable copy that keeps its settings and history in its own folder. Runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and 11.

The program is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn about it: click **More info → Run anyway**.

[Privacy](https://github.com/iRingil/ping-watch#privacy) · [How releases are built](https://github.com/iRingil/ping-watch#how-releases-are-built)
